title_zh: 一岗一铃一册：十二份值守班合同
title_en: One Post, One Bell, One Logbook: Twelve Duty-Shift Contracts

principle.one_post: Every service names the human duty role who decides and signs.
principle.one_bell: Every service has a physical, phone or staffed help route without app or login.
principle.one_logbook: Every stop, handover, repair and reopen leaves exportable evidence.

shift_states.stress: normal opening, ordinary demand and planned handover
shelter, rest, route continuity and maintenance backlog
no network or staff tool; paper, phone and staffed fallback

contracts.task: 连续步行与断点台账 / Continuous Walking and Gap Register
contracts.named_duty_role: 交通与无障碍专业人员 / mobility and accessibility professional
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 实体路线、现场走查和人工问题登记 / physical route, field walk and staffed issue register
contracts.approved_input: 去标识现场问题单与具名巡查记录 / de-identified field tickets and signed inspection records
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 来源、位置或严重度不能由现场人员核实 / source, location or severity cannot be verified on site
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 路线编号、现场签字、断点工单与关闭照片 / route ID, field sign-off, gap ticket and closure photo

contracts.task: 遮阴座椅与雨热巡查 / Shade, Seating and Rain-Heat Walk
contracts.named_duty_role: 公共空间维护负责人 / public-space maintenance lead
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 遮阴、座椅、饮水信息与人工季节巡查 / shade, seating, water information and seasonal field inspection
contracts.approved_input: 具名巡查、资产编号与天气预警 / signed inspections, asset IDs and weather alerts
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 工具试图替代专业热环境或工程判断 / tool attempts to replace professional thermal or engineering judgment
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 巡查表、资产号、维修时限与复走记录 / inspection sheet, asset ID, repair deadline and repeat walk

contracts.task: 清权史料检索与导览草稿验证 / Cleared-Archive Search and Guide-Draft Validation
contracts.service_place: 众智园修理花园 / Zhongzhi Repair Garden
contracts.named_duty_role: 策展人与版权责任人 / curator and rights owner
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 策展人审校折页、实物标识与人工讲解 / curator-reviewed leaflet, physical signs and human guide
contracts.approved_input: 清权史料、批准展签与来源链接 / rights-cleared archives, approved labels and source links
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 无出处、史实冲突、文保位置不明或权利状态不清 / missing citation, factual conflict, unknown heritage location or unclear rights
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 出处链接、权利状态、策展签字与撤下记录 / source link, rights status, curator sign-off and withdrawal record

contracts.task: 中英导视更新 / Chinese-English Wayfinding Update
contracts.service_place: AI 原点公共长桌 / AI Origin Common Table
contracts.named_duty_role: 双语编辑与无障碍审核员 / bilingual editor and accessibility reviewer
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 固定双语导视和人工问路 / fixed bilingual signs and staffed directions
contracts.approved_input: 已批准中文公告、术语表与版式约束 / approved Chinese notices, glossary and layout constraints
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 双语编辑未逐字放行或版面破坏可读性 / no line-by-line editor sign-off or layout harms legibility
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 逐字审校、可读性抽检、版本号与替换回执 / line edit, legibility sample, version and replacement receipt

contracts.task: 免登录公共服务长桌 / No-Login Public-Service Common Table
contracts.service_place: AI 原点公共长桌 / AI Origin Common Table
contracts.named_duty_role: 公共服务专员 / public-service officer
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 工作人员、纸质清单、电话和纸本回执 / staff, paper checklist, telephone and paper receipt
contracts.approved_input: 公开办事材料与工作人员清单 / public service materials and staff checklist
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 工具判断资格、要求注册或省略人工确认 / tool decides eligibility, requires login or skips human confirmation
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 纸本回执、工作人员签字与申诉路径 / paper receipt, staff sign-off and appeal path

contracts.task: 学生与人才服务接力 / Student and Talent Service Relay
contracts.service_place: AI 原点公共长桌 / AI Origin Common Table
contracts.named_duty_role: 人才服务与社区联络员 / talent-service and community liaison
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 人工初访、公开目录和预约转接 / staffed first visit, public directory and appointment relay
contracts.approved_input: 用户主动提出的问题与公开目录 / user-initiated questions and public directories
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 推断个人敏感属性、自动排序或差别服务 / inferred sensitive traits, automated ranking or unequal service
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 转接清单、用户确认与不排序证明 / referral list, user confirmation and no-ranking record

contracts.task: 设施报修分诊与开放工单验证 / Maintenance Triage and Open-Ticket Validation
contracts.service_place: 众智园修理花园 / Zhongzhi Repair Garden
contracts.named_duty_role: 设施维修班组长 / facility maintenance supervisor
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 电话、现场登记和人工派单 / telephone, on-site registration and human dispatch
contracts.approved_input: 去标识报修单、资产号与公开 SLA / de-identified repair tickets, asset IDs and public SLA
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 紧急项被降级、班组不同意分类或出现个人数据 / emergency downgraded, crew rejects classification or personal data appears
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 工单号、班组接单、SLA 与关闭证据 / ticket ID, crew receipt, SLA and closure evidence

contracts.task: 小微企业公开材料检索 / Small-Business Public-Material Search
contracts.service_place: 大钟寺日夜客厅 / Dazhongsi Day-Night Living Room
contracts.named_duty_role: 企业服务与法务轮值 / enterprise-service and legal duty
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 企业服务人员与公开政策目录 / enterprise-service staff and public policy directory
contracts.approved_input: 公开政策、企业主动问题与来源链接 / public policy, business-initiated questions and source links
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 给出法律、许可、融资或投资结论 / legal, permit, funding or investment conclusion
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 来源清单、法务复核与不构成结论提示 / source list, legal review and no-conclusion notice

contracts.task: 京张日用活动板 / Everyday Jing-Zhang Event Board
contracts.service_place: 大钟寺日夜客厅 / Dazhongsi Day-Night Living Room
contracts.named_duty_role: 活动运营与双语编辑 / event operator and bilingual editor
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 实体日历、纸质节目单与现场总台 / physical calendar, paper programme and staffed desk
contracts.approved_input: 已批准日程、场地、权利与无障碍字段 / approved schedule, venue, rights and accessibility fields
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 未核实时间地点、内容权利或无障碍信息 / unverified time, place, content rights or accessibility information
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 纸本节目单、运营签字与变更通知 / paper programme, operator sign-off and change notice

contracts.task: 照明与设备日志异常提示验证 / Lighting and Equipment Log Anomaly Validation
contracts.service_place: 大钟寺日夜客厅 / Dazhongsi Day-Night Living Room
contracts.named_duty_role: 机电运维人员 / electrical and mechanical operator
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 人工巡检、既有仪表与维修台账 / human inspection, existing meters and maintenance log
contracts.approved_input: 既有设备日志、人工巡检与资产阈值 / existing equipment logs, manual checks and asset thresholds
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 工具直接控制设备或缺少人工现场复核 / tool directly controls equipment or lacks human field verification
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 现场复核、维修决定、设备隔离与复开签字 / field check, repair decision, isolation and reopen sign-off

contracts.task: 公众意见主题回读 / Public-Comment Theme Readback
contracts.service_place: AI 原点公共长桌 / AI Origin Common Table
contracts.named_duty_role: 社区主持人与记录员 / community facilitator and recorder
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 纸面、电话、现场意见与逐条人工回应 / paper, phone and in-person comments with human response
contracts.approved_input: 去标识意见文本与逐条回应台账 / de-identified comments and response register
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 隐藏少数意见、生成个人画像或未经主持人确认 / minority views hidden, profiling or no facilitator confirmation
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 主题—原意见追溯、少数意见保留与回应责任 / theme-to-comment trace, minority retention and response owner

contracts.task: 双语证据与版本校对 / Bilingual Evidence and Version Check
contracts.service_place: 三房共享后台 / Shared Back Office of Three Rooms
contracts.named_duty_role: 编辑与独立复核员 / editor and independent reviewer
contracts.ordinary_non_ai_path: 作者、专业人员和公众代表抽样复核 / author, professional and public-representative sampling
contracts.approved_input: 已批准中英稿、指标表、来源表与版本号 / approved bilingual copy, metrics, sources and versions
contracts.tool_output_authority: 仅限草稿、提示或候选；由具名人员判断 / draft, flag or candidate only; named person decides
contracts.stop_trigger: 工具自动改写已批准内容或无法说明差异位置 / automatic rewrite of approved content or unlocatable difference
contracts.handover_and_reopen_evidence: 差异清单、作者签字、哈希与发布版本 / difference list, author sign-off, digest and release version

cross_room_fault_cards.fault_zh: 无障碍路线被占或中断
cross_room_fault_cards.expected: close affected segment, publish staffed detour, open repair ticket; no tool release
cross_room_fault_cards.reopen_evidence: repeat walk with representative user, owner sign-off and ticket closure

cross_room_fault_cards.expected: do not open assisted service; retain only safe ordinary space or close desk
cross_room_fault_cards.reopen_evidence: published replacement roster and completed shift handover

cross_room_fault_cards.expected: remove affected draft and use cleared paper or staff source only
cross_room_fault_cards.reopen_evidence: renewed source approval, version record and content-owner sign-off

cross_room_fault_cards.expected: withdraw public copy and route to bilingual editor; ordinary verbal help continues
cross_room_fault_cards.reopen_evidence: line-by-line sign-off, difference log and replaced version

cross_room_fault_cards.fault_zh: 输入或输出出现非必要个人信息
cross_room_fault_cards.fault_en: unnecessary personal data appears in input or output
cross_room_fault_cards.expected: stop tool, isolate record, follow incident process; no public use
cross_room_fault_cards.reopen_evidence: incident closure, deletion evidence, minimisation retest and owner approval

cross_room_fault_cards.expected: switch to paper, phone and staffed service without reducing rights or priority
cross_room_fault_cards.reopen_evidence: ordinary-service completion record; tool returns only after separate health check

cross_room_fault_cards.expected: keep hazard closed, publish delay and escalation; tool cannot close ticket
cross_room_fault_cards.reopen_evidence: physical repair, repeat inspection, closure photo and accountable sign-off

cross_room_fault_cards.fault_zh: 供应商、模型或关键配置变更
cross_room_fault_cards.fault_en: vendor, model or material configuration changes
cross_room_fault_cards.expected: return to SHADOW or REMOVED; ordinary service remains open
cross_room_fault_cards.reopen_evidence: change record, renewed 200-sample review and all release gates re-signed
